title: K2 Space media frame
description: A stand-in for any photo or video: a square-cornered dark surface with a faint blue light rising from the bottom edge, that crops a real image or video like object-fit cover. With scrub on, its content settles from 115% and a 6px blur to sharp while the frame scrolls into view.
notes: empty, it is aria-hidden and never draws the subject it replaces
it carries its own `dark` scope so it reads as footage on a light page too
the scrub is CSS only (off under reduced motion); pass timeline when the frame sits inside a horizontal scroller
